name: readme-parity
title: The two front doors stay in step, which nothing holds
description: A census of the repository tree found no orphan: every directory is named in the specs or is tool content, and the two READMEs are structurally identical at 31 headings, 33 code fences and 14 table rows each. That parity is maintained by hand and nothing checks it, and a future edit to one language only is the drift
